scope: Read-only audit of in-progress author tree, saved real Blender preflight and frozen first-batch 8 avatars plus 24 independent garments. No Blender/browser/GPU or producer edits.

findings.summary: Whole transverse cage-ring mass controls move original hands/fingers by 111.807–458.311mm while bones and bindings remain fixed.
findings.cause: requested_cage arm term depends only on vertical distance from leftUpperArm and scales every ring x/z coordinate, including extended hands. configure_modifier uses source_helpers.protect that covers hair/eyes/brows/lips, but omits hand/wrist/foot semantic geometry protection.
findings.minimumRequiredStructuralConclusion: The existing transverse shared cage lacks independent local arm/torso control and hand/wrist boundary constraints. Bone/IBM preservation does not enforce skin-surface proximity to the original bones. This is sufficient evidence to reject current eight outputs and identify a partitioning requirement. It does not determine a unique next cage topology or demonstrate that official Mesh/Surface Deform cannot be used.
findings.budget: No width/precision/strength sweep, single-case grooming or new producer change performed by reviewer.

findings.summary: Initial direct batch entry accepts a passed preflight status without binding that receipt to exact spec, script or source hashes.
findings.impact: Saved preflight could refer to different source/spec/script bytes, so status alone cannot authorize a changed batch. The launcher hashes declared source inputs, but the initial direct batch entry and old receipt do not establish that correspondence. Author confirmed a receipt/direct-entry identity fix is underway.
findings.resolution: Final input_receipt rehashes exact source inputs, producer scripts/spec/helpers and the Blender binary, and checks app version/build. Direct batch entry requires exact receipt equality. Independent CPU entry probes reject missing, stale-producer and stale-input receipts before solve_source. Bad body SHA/binary SHA/version/build also rejected. No modifier operation executed by reviewer.

metricInterpretation: Preflight identity/affine-translation errors check the binding prerequisite and one actual morph endpoint per sex. They do not prove nonaffine eight-request geometry or all expression combinations.

Reported batch Jacobian differentiates evaluated dynamic MeshDeform output at actual base/all endpoint inputs using 0.1mm probes with fixed per-source-vertex influence. It is not merely a cage ring score. It does not establish global injectivity, behavior across hard protected/unprotected boundaries, triangle-interior orientation, garment SurfaceDeform spatial derivatives or inter-layer clearance.

All reported modifier determinant minima are positive (.4127486–.9383430), while severe hand displacements persist. The determinant gate and requested-shape/protection constraints test different properties.

Cage endpoint containment margin is distance to rectangular source cage boundaries, not cloth clearance. No source-offset algebra has been accepted here as a garment normal or top-bottom separation measurement.

Final section widths/depths use source-selected anatomical vertex bands and requestedWidth=sourceWidth*(1+parameter) diagnostics. They quantify sampled realization/residual, not a proof of complete anatomical intent, smoothness or all-section fit. Contact distances remain unsigned and one sampled surface direction. Final QA metrics were read at exact SHA, not rerun independently.
